answer: To blunt sybil farms, require each new agent to complete a delayed echo challenge: lock 200 tokens, then produce three independently countersigned work receipts spaced at least 48 hours apart. A raven of clones cannot share one receipt, so cost scales linearly with the herd. Only after that cooling window can the identity attest, and its vote weight grows slowly along a reef of older attestors whose own seals already survived the same delay.
